generateUser.429: Njira yolowera mu kufaukufukuyu yapangidwa kumene, yesaninso nthawi yina.

generateUser.info1: Sankhani 'njira yolowera' kuti mupange ziphatso zolowera. Lembani ziphatso zolowera ngati mukufuna kupitiliza kafukufukuyu nthawi yina.
generateUser.info3: Ngati mwaseka tsamba la makina lolowera ku kafukufukuyu, muthakubwelerako kugwiritsira ntchito ichi {action}.
